scope: Native completion and orbital/state evidence; does not approve or install a model.
method: Full same-geometry MO transforms, native CI and energies. No cross-geometry overlap; printed AO amplitudes are not populations; occupation thresholds do not select a CAS. Orbital excerpts list at most 12 largest printed amplitudes; full tables remain in the hash-bound native outputs and full coefficients in the XML used for overlaps.

model.chemical_note: CAS(5,4) reduction from the completed fixed CAS(9,6) diagnostic natural orbitals. Close source natural 17/18 (occupations about 1.996/1.980 near, 1.999/1.980 far); retain 19-22, the two SH p directions and two carbon-frontier directions. Four doublets and two quartets with equal per-state weights keep both singlet-fragment SH components and the triplet-fragment spin-coupling comparison in the orbital optimization. This is a probe, not a claim that the spectator orbitals are unnecessary after relaxation.
